description: DRY-07: CacheCoordinator.fetch_from_cache checks CacheManager.get (which checks config.load + memory_cache) then checks memory_cache again — redundant read. CacheCoordinator.store_to_cache writes to memory_cache AND calls CacheManager.set (which also writes to memory_cache) — double write, double LRU eviction. Remove direct @memory_cache references; delegate through @cache_manager which already handles both layers.
title: DRY: Remove redundant MemoryCache access in CacheCoordinator
